name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted status page and incident dashboard in the lightweight setup: a libSQL database and no automated monitoring or analytics.

alerts.message: No email provider is configured, so login links are not mailed. Enter your email on the login page, then open the URL printed after '>>> Magic Link:' in the openstatus service logs. The first sign-in creates your account and workspace.

The public status page is served on status.<your domain> and only shows a page whose custom domain matches that host, which a self-hosted dashboard cannot save. After creating a page, open a shell in the openstatus service and run this, replacing status.example.com with status.<your domain> and my-page with your page slug: curl -s http://openstatus-db:8080/ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"statements":[{"q":"UPDATE page SET custom_domain = ? WHERE slug = ?","params":["status.example.com","my-page"]}]}'
New workspaces get the free plan limits (one status page, three components). Raise them in the database as described in the upstream guide.
